title: Narrow terminated-string construction
summary: Recovered Game.exe VA 0x415b00..0x415b51, RVA 0x15b00, as a genuine thiscall member with one callee-cleaned stack argument and EAX=this. Writes capacity=15 at +20, length=0 at +16 and byte zero at +0 before examining source. Scans to the first NUL, delegates the original pointer and 32-bit byte count to external range assignment at 0x416520, discards that helper's result, and returns this. The remaining inline bytes are not initialized. This is construction, not destruction/reassignment of prior owned storage. Direct immutable-original disassembly and literal/output-object callers at 0x4307b0 and 0x4307ce inspected; all three executed reference spans independently compared byte-for-byte with Game.exe. No Ghidra import was needed to resolve this bounded routine. Readable source was compiled by GCC and supplied VS2013; generated VS2013 code inspected, with no matching-source claim.
test_description: Freestanding i386 GCC differential harness passed 288 cases against original_narrow_construct_terminated at its original address. All external lengths 0..15 with high-bit characters, four initial byte patterns, four prior capacity patterns (0,15,16,UINT_MAX), plus base-source alias and empty source at inline offset 15. Exact full-object and before/after guard comparisons verify initialization, length, capacity, terminator and untouched inline bytes; external source including bytes past first NUL remains unchanged. Recovered member's test adapter verifies pre-helper object state, source identity, count and one dispatch, then executes the accepted original range helper and deliberately returns null to confirm constructor return identity is independent of helper result. Original range executes the exact memcpy-import thunk with a 4-byte .test_iat controlled copy callback. Explicit initialized test-owned FS setup must succeed; FS head restoration checked after each original call. Local linked reference sections verified equal to original (81,247,6 bytes). Implementation compiled with supplied VS2013 helper at O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-; native coordinator validation remains independent.
known_limits: Range assignment remains an external member dependency, not another recovered implementation. Inputs longer than 15 trigger original growth at 0x416890 and are not executed by this harness. The scan and delegation are recovered from the complete target instructions; allocator, growth, failure and throwing semantics remain outside this task.

Only readable NUL-terminated pointers are supported. Null, unterminated input, inaccessible memory and extreme address wraparound are not executed; the original has no pointer validation. No safety behavior is invented.

Base alias demonstrates initialization before scanning. Nonempty overlapping input and sources inside length/capacity fields are not validated. Construction does not release a preexisting allocation and is intended for uninitialized storage.

The layout and ABI target 32-bit x86. A 64-bit native string layout requires separate integration work. The exposed member models the original constructor operation and explicit return value, rather than claiming recovery of original C++ type spelling.

The controlled memcpy callback validates ordinary copy effects, not CRT internals. FS support covers normal-path registration only; Windows exception dispatch and unwind remain unavailable. No compiler-built byte matching or whole-game completion claim is made.
